findings.label: Skill invocation is already mandatory above 0.8 so recommendation already drives skill use
Advisor command bridges are keyed on slash markers and cannot surface a command from natural language
Confidence is capped at 0.95 with a 0.05 ambiguity margin so a confidence gate fires on ties
The recommended skill routes to references and never to the command assets
Executing the plan workflow costs about 16k tokens of YAML before any packet work
The workflow default confirm mode adds four approval prompts and auto mode skips the folder gate
The workflow already resolves child dispatch so a dispatched child can run it without stalling
Gate 4 arbitrates command versus tool routing but has no rule for command versus chat
The cheapest version of mechanism E is one pointer line in the skill plus the YAML read cost

ruledOutDetailed.reason: The ceiling is 0.95 and ties are common, so the gate would fire on ambiguity rather than resolve it.
